content.title: About
content.content: Breadsticks are dry, crunchy wheat‑flour products baked to a golden crust. This version is hard in texture and has reduced sodium (2453 mg per 100 g), making it more suitable for people monitoring their salt intake.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The hard texture is achieved by longer baking at low humidity.
Sodium reduction is done by replacing part of the salt with herbs and spices.
Breadsticks are a traditional Mediterranean snack served with dips and cheeses.
In Italy a similar product is called “grissini” and is often served with olive oil.
The sturdy shape makes them convenient for long‑term storage without losing crispness.

items.title: Reduced sodium
items.content: Lower sodium helps maintain normal blood pressure for individuals limiting salt consumption.

items.title: Source of complex carbohydrates
items.content: Wheat flour provides a slow release of energy, contributing to prolonged satiety.

items.title: Contains dietary fiber
items.content: In modest amounts, breadsticks supply fiber that supports digestive health.

items.title: Versatile pairing
items.content: The hard texture makes them ideal as a base for canapés, cheese plates, and dips, expanding dietary options.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Breadsticks contain wheat, so they are unsuitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: High calorie density
items.content: Despite reduced sodium, the product remains calorie‑dense; portion control is important for weight management.

items.title: Hard texture
items.content: Young children and individuals with chewing difficulties may find these sticks hard to eat.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Breadsticks can be enjoyed as a snack on their own, served with olive oil, hummus, cheese spreads, or used as a crunchy base for canapés. For extra aroma, lightly warm them in the oven before serving.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep in an airtight container in a cool, dry place. For extended storage, refrigerate to prevent moisture absorption and loss of crispness. Discard any sticks showing mold or off‑odors.
